findings.text: the implement role omits the canonical Test Visibility block even though the worker-context study rates the no-hidden-failures test guidance High and says to retain it for implementation and test workers; the test role includes it at line 116, so the missing required rule is specific to implement.

the shared map selects the whole global Commit Discipline and Branch Hygiene chunks into every worker role, so every digest says Always commit and push and Always commit to the project's primary branch before later saying workers never push the primary branch; this is coordinator-only material leaked into all four worker digests and leaves their delivery authority contradictory.

the canonical-floor gate proves eleven marker strings are present but has no per-role required-heading assertion and no forbidden/coordinator-content assertion, so all 15 cases pass while implement lacks Test Visibility and every digest carries the conflicting push instructions.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 56c466d28975453adb8b3f02c6638b8e74a85fe7; the first adds the generator, four digests and focused tests, and the second adds the plan/evidence/figure landing, with no other path.
item_verdicts.done_when: the named gate passes 15 cases at 09edcdc27ef225250d9eea55f57795c23a3554ca and its recorded negative control fails on the removed git-safety marker, but the gate measures marker presence rather than the study's per-role High-rule and coordinator-exclusion requirements.
item_verdicts.goal: read the dispatched goal and all four generated digests at the reviewed head; report, review and test retain every applicable critical/high study rule, while implement alone is missing Test Visibility and all four contain coordinator-only delivery text.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the worker manifest and each cited receipt; the 15-pass focused gate, byte-identical generation, sizes, negative-control refusal and four unchanged wider-suite failures are supported by the named files, while the semantic omissions are not reported there.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the nine changed paths all lie inside the six declared scope entries: the generator, digest directory, focused test, cumulative evidence page, figure directory and plan page.

justifications.durability: tests/test_worker_digest.py:203 detects deletion of the eleven marker strings and byte drift, but cannot redden on the missing implement-only Test Visibility heading or on coordinator-only text appearing in a worker digest.
justifications.evidence: review-gate.log independently reproduces 15 passed at the exact head and role-audit.log sees all 8 known canonical headings before finding implement at 5 of 6 applicable categories and coordinator markers in every role.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/worker_digest.py:95 uses a clear deterministic explicit map, but its whole-chunk granularity at lines 75 and 81 imports mutually incompatible global/coordinator instructions into worker-facing artefacts.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/worker_digest.py:106 omits Test Visibility from implement while line 116 correctly includes it for test, and role-audit.log records the resulting role-specific High-rule failure.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff from 56c466d28975453adb8b3f02c6638b8e74a85fe7 to the reviewed head touches only declared files, but reckon/crew/digests/*.md carry coordinator-owned push, dispatch-contract and session-audit duties not implied by a worker digest.
